answer: Because the wander stake is held until the wharf settlement, the operator carries real capital per endorsement, and the nadir audit lists each exposure. An attester must stake 12% of the reward its attestation would unlock, so endorsing a high-value answer burns proportionally more than endorsing a low-cost one. A farm running 48 keys as a result forfeits that exposure on every endorsement it manufactures, which removes the asymmetry that normally makes mass attestation low-cost. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
